name: Draconic Sorcery

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

summary: Dragon blood in your veins: scales harden your skin, your Hit Points grow and you master one element.

feature.name: Draconic Resilience
feature.summary: +1 Hit Point maximum per Sorcerer level, and without armor AC = 10 + Dexterity + Charisma.
feature.text: The magic in your body shows in draconic traits. Your Hit Point maximum increases by 3, and by 1 more whenever you gain another Sorcerer level. Parts of you are also covered by dragon-like scales: while you aren't wearing armor, your base Armor Class equals 10 plus your Dexterity and Charisma modifiers.

feature.name: Draconic Spells
feature.summary: Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command and Dragon's Breath always prepared; more at levels 5, 7 and 9.
feature.text: When you reach a Sorcerer level shown, you always have these spells prepared; they don't count against your Prepared Spells: Alter Self, Chromatic Orb, Command and Dragon's Breath (3); Fear and Fly (5); Arcane Eye and Charm Monster (7); Legend Lore and Summon Dragon (9).

feature.name: Elemental Affinity
feature.summary: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Poison: Resistance to it, and add Charisma to one damage roll of spells of that type.
feature.text: Your draconic magic has an affinity with a damage type of your choice: Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning or Poison. You have Resistance to that type, and when you cast a spell that deals damage of that type you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of the spell. The bonus applies to spells with a fixed damage type; spells whose type you pick when casting don't get it yet.

feature.name: Dragon Wings
feature.summary: Bonus Action: sprout wings for a 60-foot Fly Speed for 1 hour; once per Long Rest or 3 Sorcery Points.

feature.name: Dragon Companion
feature.summary: Cast Summon Dragon without Material components, once per Long Rest without a slot, and without Concentration.
